title: Self-Interacting Dark Matter (Spergel & Steinhardt)
efc_relevance: Dark matter with non-zero self-scattering cross section σ/m ∼ 0.1–1 cm²/g addresses cusp-core, diversity, and Bullet Cluster morphology. EFC's stance: no new particle; dense-regime cluster behaviour explained by entropic return to Newtonian. SIDM and EFC are orthogonal hypotheses on the same data (Bullet, AS1063, cluster cores) — direct predictions differ.
ledger_action: Logged as primary particle-sector DM alternative. Tested by AS1063 JWST (2602.15940); bears on Bullet δκ test.
